steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Apply the requested tenant behavior that prevents vendor addition during creation.
Apply the requested tenant configuration for stage additions.
Provide the required draft title so the draft can be saved.
Use the RFQ stage named by the test case.
Configure the RFQ stage before saving the draft.
Apply a template so the draft has a valid configured stage.
Add the minimum line item needed for a usable eRFX draft.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before saving.
Create the saved, unpublished draft required by the scenario.
Confirm the draft save completed without an application error.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Show saved drafts as required by the scenario.
Open the draft created for this test.
Open the RFQ configuration context on the saved draft.

args.goal: On the RFQ saved-draft Configuration for Event window, clear or deselect every mandatory radio or selection that the screen allows, click Save, and stop when the app visibly shows the resulting required-selection validation errors.

steps.note: Perform the configuration-window interaction whose controls and mandatory selections are screen-specific.
Assert that saving the empty mandatory selections produced a validation error.
